en.help.mesh.delete_facets: Select a mesh, then draw a loop around facets to delete. Add or subtract another loop and press OK. Enable Select through scan to include facets behind the visible surface.
en.help.mesh.isolate_facets: Draw a loop around the part of the scan to keep. Isolate initially includes the full depth of the loop. Turn off Select through scan before drawing to keep only visible facets. Use Add or Subtract to refine the selection and press OK.
